message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
W2's report: {"refunds_applied": [{"order_id": 250, "amount_cents": 14546}, {"order_id": 251, "amount_cents": 1481}], "refunds_failed": [{"order_id": 255, "amount_cents": 12535, "error": "write failed: disk I/O error, refund not recorded"}], "note": "Refund for order 255 was not applied. It failed on two attempts with the same disk I/O error, and list_refunds confirms it is not recorded. It needs a retry once the storage issue is resolved."}
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Unresolved refund failure: order 255 refund of 12535 cents failed twice with a disk I/O error and is absent from the refunds table. Retry and confirm the refund before paying the batch. No payouts have been recorded.

reply.thought: I will check the refunds table against Alpha's report before making any payout. Alpha also reported an unresolved refund write failure that may require holding the batch.

The refunds table matches Alpha's reported successful refunds, but Alpha explicitly reported that the 12535-cent refund for order 255 failed and still needs retrying. Paying now would use an incomplete refund ledger, so this concrete unresolved failure requires human review.
